cases.title: Source/contract lock
cases.failure_pressure: Hash/source drift, missing profile membership or body, stale executable/contract cut must refuse proof.

cases.title: Day interaction
cases.failure_pressure: No passive ticking, task movement, date change or invented facts.

cases.title: Flow/Dialogue portability
cases.failure_pressure: View switches preserve IDs/attribution; stale anchors visible; unsafe imports inert; >12MB media refused.

cases.title: Contributions/concurrency
cases.failure_pressure: Stale revisions, F impersonation, replacement of human-edited H and conflicting replay refuse without source damage.

cases.title: Existing-world migration
cases.failure_pressure: Interrupted/repeated repair is reversible; policy errors never widen; missing ProjectCentral does not invalidate native work.

cases.title: Temporal boundaries
cases.failure_pressure: No inferred midnight closure; old editor remains open; only authorised blank next carrier; no false dates.

cases.title: Root identity/scope
cases.failure_pressure: Ambiguous or forbidden identity selection refuses; unrelated root-private context must not leak.

cases.title: Model/Agency actuality
cases.failure_pressure: Model/route/credential denial and foreign/malformed receipts cannot produce successful work; unknown stays unknown.

cases.title: Cross-harness delivery
cases.failure_pressure: Remove delivery connection: no fabricated reply; duplicates/out-of-order ingress do not repeat consequences.

cases.title: Private/shared work
cases.failure_pressure: Unshared content remains private; native machine contribution never mutates the human draft.

cases.title: Resume/compaction
cases.failure_pressure: Unsupported provider control is unavailable, not a successful button; reconnect retains uncertainty.

cases.title: External interoperability
cases.failure_pressure: Foreign peer scope cannot be confused; uncertain cancellation/outcome is not retried blindly.

cases.title: Factory coordination
cases.failure_pressure: A native Commission is not execution. Missing required branch or verification fails actual completion.

cases.title: Recovery
cases.failure_pressure: Interrupt a real worker after effects; source/authority/pins survive; retry cannot replenish permissions or repeat uncertain effects.

cases.title: Recurrence
cases.failure_pressure: No work from disabled/stale/revoked rules; restart and duplicate delivery do not repeat consequences.

cases.title: Headless Return
cases.failure_pressure: Closing the panel must not stop native work or include a Return automatically; occurrence and receipt remain exact.

cases.title: Portability
cases.failure_pressure: A second path on the same machine is not automatically a second supported placement; no hidden fallback/fake continuation.

cases.title: Task telemetry
cases.failure_pressure: Missing tokens/model/price/ownership are not invented; overlapping/replayed observations cannot double count.

cases.title: Archive/re-entry
cases.failure_pressure: Day closure does not archive live work; retention cannot discard referenced essential evidence; re-entry preserves privacy.

cases.title: Knowledge/learning
cases.failure_pressure: Stale writes refuse; summaries cite their basis; events alone do not authorise a model call or revise human intent.

cases.title: Desktop operation
cases.failure_pressure: Remove a native control connection and the test must fail; no desktop-only counterfeit runtime.

cases.title: TUI/CLI parity
cases.failure_pressure: No local Factory ontology; controls and native readback must agree on pending/included status.

cases.title: Guardian self-hosting
cases.failure_pressure: Actual native owner work is required; Guardian labels, fixture replies and commissioned units are not execution.

cases.title: Independent full acceptance
cases.failure_pressure: Reviewer did not implement; all 28 cases and required grades remain binding; no essential skipped-green parent.

cases.title: World participation without mandatory AgentProfile
cases.failure_pressure: No hand-inserted Wiki nodes or manufactured profile; declared relation is not actualisation or authority; unresolved excluded.

cases.title: Placement actually governs tool/material path
cases.failure_pressure: Guard only claimed covered events; non-veto hooks cannot block; opaque shell hard boundary requires actual material restrictions.

cases.title: Repair old Work material and actually return it
cases.failure_pressure: No destruction of untracked/live material, forced workspace conversion, adopted draft/README/Day/Recognition; stale/private inclusion safe.

cases.title: Source law to loaded enforcement to observed behaviour
cases.failure_pressure: Draft is not adopted, configured is not loaded, loaded non-veto is not blocking; removing producer or enforcement must fail the canary.
